findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: home_verdict, below_market_deals, get_home · Private data: home_verdict, below_market_deals · Public sink: home_verdict, below_market_deals.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: home_verdict, below_market_deals, get_home · Private data: home_verdict, below_market_deals · Public sink: home_verdict, below_market_deals

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "home_verdict" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
